messages:
Rina (PM): Quick sync: usability tests show users accidentally revoking keys when they mean to copy. Need safer affordances and clearer copy.
Elliot (Design): Proposal A: keep Copy as primary, move Revoke into overflow with icon+label. Proposal B: show Disable (softer word) and an undo banner.
Aziz (Frontend): Overflow + undo banner is implementable. Mobile needs action sheet. Icon-only buttons must have aria-label.
Dee (A11y): Make sure overflow is keyboard accessible and that the undo banner is focusable and announced by screen readers. Disabled CTA must include explanatory text in DOM, not just tooltip.
Marta (Backend): We store soft-deleted keys for 10m. UI can show a 2m undo window; backend retains full trace for audit. Compliance ticket may be required if we surface retention.
Rina (PM): Copy idea: use 'Disable key' in UI with small note 'logged as revoke in audit'. This balances user perception and legal terminology.
Elliot (Design): Empty state: if user can't create keys show CTA 'Create key' plus inline note 'Admins only — request access' (link). For disabled CTAs keep text visible.
Aziz (Frontend): Row layout: increase row height slightly for overflow affordance and badges (role, last used). Add hover card with created/last-used timestamps.
Dee (A11y): Provide aria-describedby for the hover card and ensure focus order doesn't skip it.
FlagBot: Reminder: open compliance ticket C-449 if UI exposes audit retention windows.
Rina (PM): Action items: Elliot to post mocks with desktop/mobile; Dee to write a11y checklist; Aziz/Marta to estimate dev/backlog. I'll collate copy options here.
